pages.title: Paris
pages.extract: Paris is the capital and largest city of France, with an estimated city population of 2.04 million in an area of 105.4 km2 (40.7 sq mi), and a metropolitan population of 13.2 million as of January 2026. pages.title: Festival Paris Cinéma
pages.extract: The Festival Paris Cinéma is one of the most recent French movie festivals, started in 2003. It is held annually in July. It was launched in 2003 after the municipal government withdrew funding for Festival du Film de Paris.

pages.title: International Federation of Film Archives
pages.extract: The International Federation of Film Archives (French: Fédération internationale des archives du film, FIAF) is a film preservation organization founded in Paris in 1938 by the Cinémathèque Française, the Reichsfilmarchiv in Berlin, the British Film Institute and the Museum of Modern Art in New York...

pages.title: Autonomous Port of Paris
pages.extract: The Autonomous Port of Paris (French: "Port autonome de Paris") is a public institution in France that was set up in 1970.
